text:
evan: Quick benchmark request — can someone run a latency + throughput sweep for talon-7b-v2 (new hf release). Target: seq lengths 256/1024/2048, focus on 1024. Aim to collect p50/p95/p99, tail-latency traces, and token/sec for batch sizes 1/4/8. Test on A100 and H100 if available. Please include quantized int8 and fp16 profiles. Use our standard benchset (2k prompts). I need this for the rollout doc by EOD tomorrow.

maria: I can kick this off on A100 today. Will run smoke first and then full sweep. tagging @perf-bot for artifacts.

perf-bot: Artifact upload started: http://artifacts.redwood/talon7bv2/smoke/1735092467/logs.tar.gz :inbox_tray:

maria: smoke results (A100, fp16, seq=1024, batch=4) 
```
summary: p50=48ms p95=112ms p99=190ms tokens/s=950 mem=12.1G
notes: stable KV cache, no OOMs
```

kevin: Thanks. Can you also try batch=1 and int8? curious about single-request latency vs cost. Also slice seq=2048 but shorter run (100 prompts) to check tail behavior.

maria: running int8 now. command: 
```bash
./run_bench --model talon-7b-v2 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant int8 --prompts benchset_v2.json --out talon_int8_1024.json
```

maria: int8 (A100, seq=1024, batch=1): p50=43ms p95=105ms p99=260ms tokens/s=1100 mem=8.6G. p99 spiked on some 2k-token prompts, looks like attention kernel fallback.

sara: I looked at the profiler trace maria uploaded. Flamegraph shows a hotspot in fused-attn-kernel at longer seqlen and some memcpy spikes around KV cache eviction. Link: http://perf.redwood/flames/talon7bv2/1735092600

sara: quick suggestion: try lower kv_cache_shard_size (set --kv-shard 128 -> 64) to reduce memcpy thrash for 2k seqs, and rerun batch=4.

maria: reran batch=4, seq=2048, kv-shard=64 (short run 100 prompts): p50=210ms p95=520ms p99=980ms tokens/s=420 mem=14.3G. Much less variance vs previous.

kevin: Good call. Can you also run H100 fp16 batch=4/8 when you have capacity? we'll compare throughput. If H100 not available, note that in results.

maria: H100 queued, ETA ~2h. If it doesn't finish I'll push current A100 full sweep results.

perf-bot: Full A100 sweep artifacts uploaded: http://artifacts.redwood/talon7bv2/full_sweep/1735092800/ (logs + traces + csv)

evan: Awesome, thanks team. After H100 run, can one of you open a short PR to /docs/onboarding/models with the latency table and a short recommendation: "use int8 for cost-sensitive low-latency requests, prefer kv-shard tweak for >1k seqs". I can draft text if needed.

maria: I'll open the PR after H100 completes. Preliminary takeaway: talon-7b-v2 is ~12% slower than our reference (sparrow-6b) at seq=1024 fp16 but gains back throughput in int8 and uses ~30% less memory. Worth flagging as a cost-performance tradeoff.

kevin: added a quick note to the ticket: run inference smoke before routing traffic; fallback to sparrow-6b for tail-heavy workloads if p99 > 800ms.

evan: Perfect. If H100 run finishes, ping here with the artifact link and final numbers. :thumbsup:

maria: H100 done: (fp16, seq=1024, batch=4) p50=34ms p95=78ms p99=160ms tokens/s=1300 mem=10.2G. Uploaded to artifacts: http://artifacts.redwood/talon7bv2/h100_run/1735092829

evan: Nice. That makes sense — H100 is ~25% lower p95 vs A100 for same config. OK to proceed with onboarding doc. I'll coordinate the PR and rollout window. Thanks everyone.

sara: filed perf follow-up issue with profiler pointers and suggested kernel tuning flags: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf/issues/487

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 — includes table + notes + links to artifacts.

evan: Closing loop — great work. We'll plan a canary for next week with traffic shaping.
